reviews.title: Big change in temps, exceeded my expectations right out of the box.
reviews.comment:
Moved my last build into a new case,  replaced my huge air cooler with the MAG CORELIQUID A15 240.
This is my first experience using liquid cooling. I had the biggest baddest air cooler and wasn't real happy with it's performance in my 14900k build. Figured I'd give this cooler a shot, I was moving into a new case anyway.
The install was easy, not any more difficult than installing any other cooler. I was pleasantly surprised when I first fired up the rebuild, my temps were down considerably compared to my air cooler with the 240 cooler installed in the top panel. Then I moved it to the front panel to see what happens since I had plenty of room in the new case.  The result was better, I was able to push my tune and bench marks a little bit higher.
The fans that come with the cooler aren't bad, they're quiet, push a decent amount of air and don't require a fan header that pulls over 1amp.
If you're going to do a push pull configuration you'll need to get extra fan screws separately. The kit does not include extra fans screws, only the screws on the pre installed fans. There are plenty of case screws.
The 360 A15 will be my next liquid cooler for a new build. I can only imagine how the 360 A15 will perform when the 240's performance was so impressive right out of the box.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.title: Easy to Install, Great Performance. An Easy 5 Stars
reviews.comment: This is my second time using an MSI AIO and this one seals the deal for me; it's a fantastic cooler for the price. This is definitely a repeater, a product I would buy again for another build in a heartbeat, and I'd probably recommend it to anyone looking for a solid 240mm AIO. Installation was surprisingly easy, and the instructions were clear. I'm especially happy that it comes ready for the new LGA 1851 socket, so I feel confident that my system is future-proofed for the next generation of processors. Performance-wise, it's doing an excellent job keeping my CPU temperatures low and stable, even during long gaming sessions. The ARGB on the fans and pump head looks great, isn't overly flashy, and synced up with my system's software without any issues. For a hassle-free, high-performing cooler that looks clean and is ready for the future, you really can't go wrong here.
reviews.author: James Downey
